risks.title: Défis macroéconomiques et volatilité tarifaire
risks.score_rationale: Q2 2025 sales were adversely impacted by global tariff volatility, inflation, and higher interest rates. Orthodontic starts have declined for four consecutive years. Consumer economic uncertainty continues to impair discretionary spending on dental treatments. Citation: "We estimate that there are approximately 600 million people globally with malocclusion who could benefit". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Macroeconomic headwinds including tariff volatility, inflation, elevated interest rates, and declining orthodontic starts are impacting patient demand and sales performance.

risks.title: Conflits géopolitiques et risque de chaîne d'approvisionnement
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts in Ukraine, Middle East, China and other regions add market uncertainties, dampen consumer sentiment, and directly impact supply chains through tariffs and trade disputes affecting key strategic countries including US, China, Europe, Brazil, Canada, and Israel. Citation: "Given these risks and uncertainties, you should not to place undue reliance on such forward-looking". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts create supply chain vulnerabilities, market uncertainties, and potential tariff impacts across key strategic regions.
risks.title_en: Geopolitical Conflicts and Supply Chain Risk

risks.title: Fluctuations des changes et des devises
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally with international expansion as a key growth driver, making it exposed to fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates affecting revenues and costs across EMEA and APAC regions. Citation: "The patient s ClinCheck treatment plan is then made available to the prescribing dental professional". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Currency fluctuations impact international revenues and operating costs as the company pursues global expansion across multiple regions.

risks.title: Competitive Market Pressures
risks.score_rationale: Competition in clear aligner and digital dentistry solutions intensifies with traditional and emerging competitors. Market differentiation depends on continuous innovation, brand strength, and product applicability across malocclusion types. Citation: "New Products/Feature Enhancement As we further evolve the treatment planning experience for doctors through new". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competition from traditional and emerging competitors requires sustained innovation and brand differentiation in clear aligners and digital dentistry solutions.

risks.title: Réputation du produit et efficacité clinique
risks.score_rationale: Company reputation depends on clinical efficacy, product safety, and treatment outcomes. Any issues including product recalls, adverse clinical events, or litigation could damage brand and impact market adoption. Citation: "Clear Aligner Products We offer our Invisalign System in a variety of treatment packages designed". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Reputation risk from clinical efficacy concerns, product safety issues, or litigation could negatively impact brand and patient/doctor adoption.

risks.title: Risque réglementaire et de conformité
risks.score_rationale: Medical device company subject to regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions (FDA, CE, international standards). Regulatory changes, compliance burdens, and quality requirements could impact operations. Citation: "We have two operating segments: (1) Clear Aligner and (2) Imaging Systems and CAD/CAM Services". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Evolving regulatory requirements across jurisdictions and quality compliance standards must be managed to maintain operational continuity.

risks.title: Propriété intellectuelle et risque de contentieux
risks.score_rationale: Competitive market with proprietary technologies exposes company to IP disputes, patent challenges, and litigation that could be costly and impact competitive advantages. Citation: "Smart technology allows us to find the right thickness, the right elasticity, and the right". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Intellectual property disputes and litigation in competitive markets could be costly and threaten proprietary technology advantages.

company_description: Align Technology, Inc. provides Invisalign clear aligners, Vivera retainers, and iTero intraoral scanners and services in the United States, Switzerland, and internationally. The company's Clear Aligner segment offers Invisalign comprehensive package to treat adults and teens malocclusion and features, and orthodontic needs of teenage or younger patients; and Invisalign First Phase I and Invisalign First Comprehensive Phase 2 package for younger patients between the ages of six and ten years with a mixture of primary/baby and permanent teeth. This segment also provides Invisalign express, Invisalign lite, and Invisalign moderate; Invisalign Go, Invisalign Go express, and Invisalign Go Plus; retention products, Invisalign training, adjusting tools used by dental professionals during treatment, ancillary Invisalign accessory products, and other oral health products; Invisalign Professional Whitening system; Invisalign Palatal Expander, a 3D printed orthodontic device; and 3D printing solutions. risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est positionné en #3 sur 7 dans l'Item 1A (Position : moyenne). La catégorie Capital a un poids faible comparé aux risques cyber ou réglementaires (Weight : bas). Ces facteurs expliquent le score modéré de 3 sur 5.

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Competitive Market Pressures

risks_rationale_overrides.title: Product Reputation and Clinical Efficacy
risks_rationale_overrides.score_rationale: Ce risque est positionné en #5 sur 7 dans l'Item 1A (Position : moyenne), utilisant un langage d'intensité moyenne avec "could negatively impact" (Intensité : moyen). Il est stable par rapport à l'année précédente (Trend : stable), sans aggravation ni atténuation notable. enrich_ai_pos.summary: Align Technology s'impose comme un leader de l'IA en santé dentaire en 2026, avec des produits centrés sur l'automatisation clinique et la personnalisation du traitement orthodontique via des outils intégrés à grande échelle.
evidence: Lancement d'Align X-ray Insights en 2025 dans l'UE et au Royaume-Uni, solution logicielle CADe utilisant l'IA pour analyser automatiquement les radiographies 2D, améliorant l'efficacité diagnostique.

Intégration de fonctionnalités basées sur l'IA dans l'écosystème iTero Digital Solutions, notamment avec l'iTerio Lumina Pro et la technologie NIRI pour des flux numériques orthodontiques et restauratifs optimisés.
Mise en œuvre de l'IA dans des outils cliniques clés comme Invisalign Outcome Simulator Pro et Invisalign Virtual Care AI, renforçant la prévisibilité du traitement et l'engagement patient.
Améliorations continues du traitement ClinCheck via l'IA pour une personnalisation accrue des plans thérapeutiques 2D/3D, avec des simulations vidéo du sourire finales.
Présence récurrente de l'IA dans les annonces stratégiques R&D 2025, avec des innovations dédiées à l'automatisation, la détection assistée et l'expérience numérique patient-docteur.

fr.activity: Align Technology conçoit des systèmes d'orthodontie numérique et de scan intraoral.
fr.products: Ses produits phares sont les aligneurs Invisalign, les gouttières Vivera et les scanners iTero.
fr.customers: Ses clients sont les orthodontistes, dentistes et laboratoires dentaires dans le monde entier.
fr.edge: Son atout est la marque Invisalign, leader des aligneurs transparents, et l'intégration scan-traitement.

fr.positioning: Dans le sous-secteur Healthcare Technology, Align domine le marché des aligneurs transparents avec une part dominante face à SmileDirectClub et aux entrants locaux.
fr.tech_products: L'entreprise opère via deux segments : Clear Aligner (Invisalign) et Imaging Systems and CAD/CAM (iTero), avec une plateforme numérique reliant orthodontistes et fabrication.
fr.moat: Son moat repose sur les brevets, les données accumulées sur des millions de traitements et un réseau de praticiens formés à Invisalign.
fr.risks: Les risques comprennent l'expiration de brevets clés, la concurrence des aligneurs DTC et la sensibilité de la demande aux dépenses discrétionnaires.

risks.title: Macroeconomic Challenges and Tariff Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Q2 2025 sales were adversely impacted by global tariff volatility, inflation, and higher interest rates. Orthodontic starts have declined for four consecutive years. Consumer economic uncertainty continues to impair discretionary spending on dental treatments. Citation: "We estimate that there are approximately 600 million people globally with malocclusion who could benefit". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.description: Macroeconomic headwinds including tariff volatility, inflation, elevated interest rates, and declining orthodontic starts are impacting patient demand and sales performance.
risks.summary: Macroeconomic headwinds including tariff volatility, inflation, elevated interest rates, and declining orthodontic starts are impacting patient demand and sales performance.

risks.title: Geopolitical Conflicts and Supply Chain Risk
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts in Ukraine, Middle East, China and other regions add market uncertainties, dampen consumer sentiment, and directly impact supply chains through tariffs and trade disputes affecting key strategic countries including US, China, Europe, Brazil, Canada, and Israel. Citation: "Given these risks and uncertainties, you should not to place undue reliance on such forward-looking". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.description: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts create supply chain vulnerabilities, market uncertainties, and potential tariff impacts across key strategic regions.
risks.summary: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts create supply chain vulnerabilities, market uncertainties, and potential tariff impacts across key strategic regions.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange and Currency Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally with international expansion as a key growth driver, making it exposed to fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates affecting revenues and costs across EMEA and APAC regions. Citation: "The patient s ClinCheck treatment plan is then made available to the prescribing dental professional". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.description: Currency fluctuations impact international revenues and operating costs as the company pursues global expansion across multiple regions.
risks.summary: Currency fluctuations impact international revenues and operating costs as the company pursues global expansion across multiple regions.

risks.title: Competitive Market Pressures
risks.score_rationale: Competition in clear aligner and digital dentistry solutions intensifies with traditional and emerging competitors. Market differentiation depends on continuous innovation, brand strength, and product applicability across malocclusion types. Citation: "New Products/Feature Enhancement As we further evolve the treatment planning experience for doctors through new". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.description: Competition from traditional and emerging competitors requires sustained innovation and brand differentiation in clear aligners and digital dentistry solutions.
risks.summary: Competition from traditional and emerging competitors requires sustained innovation and brand differentiation in clear aligners and digital dentistry solutions.

risks.title: Product Reputation and Clinical Efficacy
risks.score_rationale: Company reputation depends on clinical efficacy, product safety, and treatment outcomes. Any issues including product recalls, adverse clinical events, or litigation could damage brand and impact market adoption. Citation: "Clear Aligner Products We offer our Invisalign System in a variety of treatment packages designed". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.description: Reputation risk from clinical efficacy concerns, product safety issues, or litigation could negatively impact brand and patient/doctor adoption.
risks.summary: Reputation risk from clinical efficacy concerns, product safety issues, or litigation could negatively impact brand and patient/doctor adoption.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Medical device company subject to regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions (FDA, CE, international standards). Regulatory changes, compliance burdens, and quality requirements could impact operations. Citation: "We have two operating segments: (1) Clear Aligner and (2) Imaging Systems and CAD/CAM Services". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.description: Evolving regulatory requirements across jurisdictions and quality compliance standards must be managed to maintain operational continuity.
risks.summary: Evolving regulatory requirements across jurisdictions and quality compliance standards must be managed to maintain operational continuity.

risks.title: Intellectual Property and Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Competitive market with proprietary technologies exposes company to IP disputes, patent challenges, and litigation that could be costly and impact competitive advantages. Citation: "Smart technology allows us to find the right thickness, the right elasticity, and the right". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.description: Intellectual property disputes and litigation in competitive markets could be costly and threaten proprietary technology advantages.
